source_facts.statement: 220-class entry has BF16/per-token TBE, OPT and BASIC <REDACTED_CREDENTIAL>, including perTokenScale input. Compile/format/transpose/template gates matter; not the no-perToken MC2 third-party header.

AIC INT32 GetTensorC writes GM workspace. AIV waits for C event, reads INT32 to UB, does FP32 processing and final yType CAST_RINT in UB, then writes yGm. When yType=BF16, the final output producer is AIV. Pre-scale/bias arithmetic is branch-specific and must not be reassociated.

GetTensorC returns GM workspace consumed as INT32 by DequantCompute, followed by per-token multiplication, optional pre-cast bias, yType CAST_RINT and UB-to-GM output. The BF16 cast can precede a subsequent Vector operation without a BF16 GM interface in a transformed graph.
AIC computes INT32 workspace, AIV waits then invokes EpilogueDequant. This is a Cube-to-Vector bridge plus a Vector output epilogue, not direct AIC BF16 ownership.

DequantCompute reads INT32 GM, dequantizes and applies per-token scale/bias; CopyOutToGM performs yType CAST_RINT in UB before GM copy. For BF16 output the legal splice point is after that cast, preserving the exact dequant arithmetic.

saved_profile_support: 22 BF16-output regimes /9671 executions have positive AIV work; INT32 GateUp control9/4472 has none. This is supporting evidence, not source-to-binary proof.
supersedes_unconditional_owner_reading_o: v80 Cube-owned BF16->Vector interface remains a valid conditional model. It is not an established ownership fact for these per-token quantized outputs.
